how_to_apply: Fill the Application Form only in Online Mode at the AMU Careers Portal (careers.amuonline.ac.in) by 14 November 2026 (upto 11:59 P.M.), following the instructions in the advertisement and the User Manual on the portal.
Fill a separate Application Form for each post listed under a different serial number of the advertisement.
Pay the non-refundable Processing Fee of Rs. 500/- online at the Careers Portal; PwD candidates upload the Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma instead.
After successful submission, take a printout of the PDF file of the Application Form on A-4 size paper.
Sign the printout and paste a recent front-facing photograph at the designated place.
Attach self-attested copies of all relevant documents listed below.
On the top-left side of the cover, write the post applied for, the advertisement number and its date.

Send it by post to: Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002. The hard copy must reach by 21 November 2026; hard copies will not be received after 04:00 p.m. on that date.

The University will not be responsible for postal delay or for late receipt/non-receipt of the Application Form. For help with the form, the Help Desk can be contacted on working days during office hours at +91-571-2700920 (Extension: 1178).

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Other eligibility points printed in the notice: Applications are invited from Indian nationals, including Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955. Qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions will be reckoned as on the last date of submission of the Application Form. The relaxation in the percentage of marks will be given as per the rule of the Government of India, wherever applicable. The prescribed qualifications and experience are minimum; holding them alone does not entitle an applicant to be called for interview. For Madrasa background applicants, a certificate equivalent to High School or Graduation will be considered if obtained from Madaris/Institution recognized by the University, wherever applicable. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. Only persons with a degree of relevant disability of at least 40% may apply for posts earmarked for PwD candidates. They must upload a Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma (Appendix-I) issued by the Competent Authority. Applicable categories: (A) Blindness and low vision (VH); (B) Deaf and hard of hearing (HH); (C) Locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid-attack victims and muscular dystrophy (OH); (D) Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness; (E) Multiple disabilities from amongst persons under clauses (A) to (D) including deaf-blindness. The Proforma/Format at Appendix-1 is available on https://www.amu.ac.in , https://www.amuregistrar.com and https://careers.amuonline.ac.in . The claim of disability of the selected applicant will be examined by the Medical Board of the University before the appointment letter is issued.

content_sections.text: The notice does not mention any allowances or the in-hand salary. Appointments will be made on a purely temporary basis, subject to termination at any time without notice or assignment of reason. The University reserves the right to get selected applicants examined by an Internal Medical Board.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The Processing Fee is non-refundable and is to be paid only in the Online Mode at the Careers Portal. As a separate form is needed for each post, the fee applies to each form.

rows.category: PwD candidates (on uploading an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through an interview before the Local Selection Committee (LSC), held in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine, AMU, Aligarh, on 30 November 2026, with verification of original documents. The University may also constitute a committee to scrutinize and short-list applications, and reserves the right to restrict the number of applicants called for interview on the basis of Rules/Criteria or any other condition it may deem fit. Candidates must report with all original documents half an hour before the scheduled time of the LSC. The notice states that no separate Notice/Interview letter will be issued to candidates in this regard. Candidates who do not bring the originals of the required documents for verification will not be allowed to appear before the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AMU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The University will not be responsible for postal delay or for late receipt/non-receipt of the Application Form. For help with the form, the Help Desk can be contacted on working days during office hours at +91-571-2700920 (Extension: 1178).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Attested photocopies of the following must be enclosed with the application form, and the originals brought for verification at the interview: All marksheets, certificates and degrees from class Xth to postgraduation High School Certificate from a Recognized Board Mark-sheet and Degree of Graduation Mark-sheet and Degree of Post-Graduation Internship completion Certificate Valid Registration of Graduation and Post graduation from NMC Certificate of NET, JRF, SLET/SET, CSIR etc. as the case may be M. Phil/Ph.D. Degree, wherever applicable Experience Certificates, wherever applicable, and other testimonial(s) No Objection Certificate from the present employer, if employed / relieving orders of all previous employers Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma (Appendix-I), for PwD candidates

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AMU Recruitment 2026 for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: one Senior Resident in the Department of Anaesthesiology and one in the Department of Radiotherapy at JNMC, AMU.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 14 November 2026 (upto 11:59 P.M.). The hard copy must reach the Dean's office by 21 November 2026, before 04:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The qualification is as per NMC norms/Residency Scheme, adopted by AMU, reckoned as on the last date of submission of the Application Form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for an AMU Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Senior Residents are placed in Pay Level AL-11.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The non-refundable Processing Fee is Rs. 500/- for each Application Form, paid online at the Careers Portal. PwD candidates are exempted if they upload an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the JNMC Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Apply online at careers.amuonline.ac.in, then post the signed printout with photograph and self-attested documents to the Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002.

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the interview?
faq.answer: The Local Selection Committee meets on 30 November 2026 in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine: 12:30 p.m. for Anaesthesiology (reporting 12:00 noon) and 01:00 p.m. for Radiotherapy (reporting 12:30 p.m.).

faq.question: Q8. Will an interview letter be sent?
faq.answer: The notice states that no separate Notice/Interview letter will be issued to candidates for the Local Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for both Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate Application Form must be filled for each post listed under a different serial number, with the fee for each form.

faq.question: Q10. Is the AMU Senior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No. Appointments will be made on a purely temporary basis, subject to termination at any time without notice or assignment of reason.
